definitions.explanation: Being able to replace or work with one another, especially of devices, software, parts, or file formats. Mostly met in compounds.

examples.japanese: {互換|ごかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧{互換|ごかん}だ。
examples.english: This new model is an upgraded, fully compatible version of the old one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{互換|ごかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}え→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}してある→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: The settings were left unchanged to keep compatibility with the old software.

notes:
Used mostly in computing and engineering; in everyday speech the noun ⟦{互換性|ごかんせい}→互換性：07654_gokansei⟧ is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{互換性|ごかんせい}→互換性：07654_gokansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be compatible
- ⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧{互換|ごかん}: upward-compatible; (casually) a strictly better version
- ⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧{互換|ごかん}: downward-compatible; a lesser version
- {互換|ごかん}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: a compatible part or product (third-party)

WATCH OUT:
Homophones: ⟦{五感|ごかん}→五感：05698_gokan⟧ (the five senses) and ⟦{語幹|ごかん}→語幹：31298_gokan⟧ (word stem).
